coordinateSystem: RD EPSG:28992 horizontal, NAP metres vertical. roofWgs84 vertices are lon,lat,NAP.
limits: Survey polygons are massing references for original geometry, not imported third-party asset. Crest/equipment maxima must not become facade body/eaves height.

modelProfileTolerance.policy: Exact official3DBAG semantic rings drive survey partition; 2cm accommodates arithmetic only, not BAG/3DBAG footprint mismatch. Source reconstruction errors recorded separately in attributes; no artificial inflation.

groundRingPolicy: GroundSurface outer and interior rings preserved per polygon; surveyFootprintPolygonsRD is grouped by actual ground polygon. Never flatten interior rings into independent solid patches.
